Dulhanama — bridal jewellery brand identity (2018).

A gold lettermark for a bridal-jewellery label: a bride's profile cut from the negative space of the "D", with a flourished script below. The mark carries through to a trifold brochure on a cream-and-gold lattice.

The identity and collateral are mine; the jewellery is the label's own.

Brand identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·11.
